fact: The World Bank's May 2025 project paper says connectivity financed under the Digital Cabo Verde parent project currently reaches high schools only, with additional financing to expand it to more schools, targeting 150 basic and secondary schools connected for pedagogical purposes by 2028.
title: Project Paper on a Proposed Additional Credit in the Amount of SDR 15.1 Million (US$ 20.0 Million Equivalent) to the Republic of Cabo Verde for the Digital Cabo Verde Project
